newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Yanhua HK IPO 11.3x subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Yanhua HK IPO 11.3x subscribed.

text.p: Beijing Yanhua Petrochemical Co Ltd said on Tuesday its Hong Kong public offering of H-shares was 11.3 times subscribed.

The Chinese resins and plastics producer said it received applications for a total 1.14 billion shares compared with 101.2 million shares available for public subscription. H-shares are shares of China incorporated companies listed in Hong Kong.

Beijing Yanhua said it had reallocated 43.01 million shares to the Hong Kong tranche from the U.S. and international offerings in accordance with a clawback arrangement, bringing the size of the Hong Kong offering to 144.21 million shares.

The Hong Kong offering price has been fixed at HK$1.76 each, exclusive of one percent brokerage and 0.013 percent of transaction levy, it said. Dealing in the company's shares in Hong Kong is due to begin on Wednesday.

SBC Warburg, one of the global coordinators of the issue, said on Monday the price of the international placement portion was fixed at HK$1.78 per share and the Hong Kong offering tranche was also priced at HK$1.78 inclusive of brokerage and transaction levy.
Beijing Yanhua issued 1.012 billion new H-shares, or 30 percent of its enlarged share capital in a global offering. SBC Warburg and Bear, Stearns & Co Inc are the global coordinators.

Of the total issue, 455.4 million shares were offered to the U.S. market in the form of American Depositary Shares (ADS). Another 455.4 million shares were for international placement with the balance for public subscription in Hong Kong.
Both the U.S. offering and the international placement were in the form of ADS securities.
